description: Daily OHLCV bars for one symbol packaged as ready-to-load files for an open-source backtester or trading framework: backtrader, backtesting_py, vectorbt, zipline (csvdir bundle), lean (QuantConnect LEAN, base64 zip), nautilus, freqtrade or qlib. Returns files (path, encoding, content) and load_code. Write each file at its path, then run load_code. Clipped to as_of; start defaults to 365 days before end.

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).

name: backtest_export
title: Export bars for a backtester
